actual_codex.evidence: current CLI startup fields, not config alone

roles.arc: all 33 exact prior image-space DATA_FREEZE cameras, native_width/native_height and original FoV/w2c; no invented cameras

exposure: exploratory previously GS/research-seen views; no new blind test
contract: view-dependent original-Gaussian stylization. All original IDs/centers/opacity/occlusion remain. Native white-background c_i=1-s_i, 0<=s<=1. No new Gaussian/curve/line primitive, final 2D contour paint, center connections, learned predictor, or original-RGB target fit.

silhouette.holes: fill every bounded background component for EXTERIOR evidence only, save holes and sizes; omit their internal contours, including potentially meaningful enclosed chair openings. Do not alter alpha or final native image. Outside-connected gaps retained. Tiny components below either threshold excluded from evidence but all Gaussians still render.
silhouette.SDF: Euclidean foreground distance minus background distance with +/-0.5 pixel-center correction; gradient gives normal, tangent=(-ny,nx); no normal from binary response ridge
silhouette.limit: fixed-T A<=native alpha; low-coverage white edge cannot be opaque with color alone

arms.A: same old gaer_ratio_0.005_ids, binary strength1; others white still occlude
arms.B: exact same A original IDs, bounded continuous joint fit to automatic alpha target
arms.C: full N original IDs jointly fit; b=AT(beta), no one-pixel winner, only exactly zero-participation nuclei held at0. Full-N capacity differs from fixed subset weights; no matched-budget superiority claim
arms.P: necessary alphaT participation baseline: top ceil(.005*N) of actual AT(beta), binary strengths; same count as A, fixed-T
arms.old_selected_only: read-only legacy SH3 images, deleting others and changing T; separate comparison

solver.algorithm: matrix-free diagonally majorized monotone FISTA; D=AT(q*alpha) gives nonnegative-weight Jensen upper Hessian diagonal. No dense H*W*N. Backtrack if necessary; bounded feasible best retained
solver.objective: sum q*(A(s)-L)^2/(2*800*800), q=4 on beta>0, otherwise1
solver.start: zero for every scene/view/frame; no warm starts, no temporal penalty or reset heuristics
solver.native_FP32: production color forward/adjoint source-consistent accepted T*alpha
solver.independent_certificate: existing isolated query linear64 full accepted weights; conservative FP64 roundoff and 3e-5 native allowance, numerical certification only

shape.conditional_trigger: C fails clean thresholds on any DEV view or has visually broad/discontinuous recognizable outline after valid controls; one bounded arm only
shape.name: S
shape.original_IDs: C support with beta participation>1e-5 and original projected center distance to exterior<=4px; no new nuclei
shape.steering: AT(beta*cos2normal), AT(beta*sin2normal) double-angle per-ID average. Screen covariance tangent variance retained, normal variance /4 with .3 floor, cross0; generalized covariance eigenvalues clipped [0.25,1] relative to original screen covariance
shape.full_pipeline: existing isolated native shape sentinel before inversion/radii/tiles; recompute traversal, native contributions and T; refit strengths with same target and budget. Original PLY unchanged
shape.prohibition: no blind shrinking of all nuclei, no further shape ratios/geometry/long trajectories to rescue

metrics.profiles: all retained exterior boundary pixels, actual native ink sampled along SDF normal at offsets -8..8 in 0.5px increments; peak, half-max width, mass location and weighted distance
metrics.continuity: boundary covered when actual normal-profile peak within [-1,3]px>=0.2; report missing runs on ordered pixel contours only as measurement, never render them
metrics.interior: SDF>4; full raw-native ink fraction and threshold pixels
metrics.temporal: original-ID active>1e-5 Jaccard, strength L1 normalized churn; per-frame quality plus target-corrected image difference (not correspondence-stable flicker proof)

thresholds.visual_GO: requires clean full exterior visual review in addition to frozen metrics; no coverage-only success

default_policy: choose C unless conditional S passes damage gate and lowers sum of normalized clean-threshold violations on DEV by>=10%; freeze choice on exactly two DEV views per scene before evaluation/arc. All failures retained.
arc_policy: if frozen method has recognizable contour on both DEV views per scene, recompute alpha target and fit every one of original33 frames. Otherwise 3 actual engineering diagnostic arc frames indices0,16,32, label STOP. Preserve bad frames, full-size native ink/RGB overlay and all-frame strip. H264 yuv420p faststart decode exact count.
outputs: experiments/gaer_object_contours_v01, artifacts/gaer_object_contours_v01, ignored out/gaer_object_contours_v01 only; atomic unit seals
science_refusal: old ALL8 selector reliability remains REFUSED; old four uncertified known-target fits unchanged. No persistent fixed3Dcurve/static edge classification/temporal stability/novelty claim. Budget-limited fits labeled uncertified, not impossibility.
